selection: Existing master-pool VALIDATION with pool_rank >= 20000; exclude IDs in recovered requests and published QA; hash-ranked within group before viewing images

review.rule: Score each category question separately; uncertain is not a clear pass. Lock scores before revealing per-prompt randomized model labels.

acceptance.adherence: 129-prompt paired clear-pass gain A minus teacher; paired bootstrap 95% lower bound must be >= -0.05
acceptance.text: 30-prompt panel: A clear passes must be >= teacher clear passes minus 1; zero clear-pass losses permitted for entirely missing requested phrases
acceptance.performance: 30-pair benchmark paired speedup bootstrap 95% lower bound must exceed 1.0
acceptance.historical_velocity: The 0.0652 historical gate remains failed and must be reported; this image panel cannot retroactively pass it.
acceptance.promotion: Passing this screen permits research on a replacement inside A, not production promotion. All replacement velocity/stage/worst-case tolerances must be registered before fitting.
